package design

import . "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/dsl"

var _ = API("suppression", func() {
	Meta("openapi:example", "false")
})
var _ = Service("svc", func() {

	Method("send", func() {

		Payload(func() {
			Attribute("authored", String, func() {
				Example("retain")
			})
			Attribute("synthesized", String)
		})
		HTTP(func() {
			POST("/send")
		})

	})
	Method("excluded", func() {
		Payload(String)
		HTTP(func() {
			POST("/excluded")
			Meta("openapi:generate", "false")
		})
	})

})
